quote: However, when prolonged external stimuli exceed the capacity of the antioxidant system, oxidative stress ensues, resulting in tissue damage.
statement: 然而，当长期的外部刺激超过抗氧化系统的能力时，就会发生氧化应激，导致组织损伤。
text_zh: 然而，当长期的外部刺激超过抗氧化系统的能力时，就会发生氧化应激，导致组织损伤。
text_en: However, when long-term external stimuli exceed the capacity of the antioxidant system, oxidative stress occurs, leading to tissue damage.

quote: Stress inevitably occurs during any ﬁ sh handling and manipulation in culturing, research, or clinical examination situations that require capture and removal of ﬁ sh from water.
statement: 在养殖、研究或临床检查中，任何需要捕获和将鱼从水中取出的操作和处理都会不可避免地产生应激。
text_zh: 在养殖、研究或临床检查中，任何需要捕获和将鱼从水中取出的操作和处理都会不可避免地产生应激。
text_en: In aquaculture, research, or clinical examination, any operation and handling that requires capturing fish and removing them from the water will inevitably produce stress.

quote: Different stress factors can affect the changes in the relative numbers and function of cells of the ﬁ sh immune system.
statement: 不同的应激因素会影响鱼类免疫系统细胞的相对数量和功能变化。
text_zh: 不同的应激因素会影响鱼类免疫系统细胞的相对数量和功能变化。
text_en: Different stress factors affect the relative number and functional changes of immune system cells in fish.

quote: Catching, transportation and over-crowding caused stress-induced changes in the total number of leukocytes and thrombocytes, as well as changes in the leukocyte formula in Prussian carp (Carassius gibelio, Bloch, 1782) presented here.
statement: 本研究中展示的银鲫（Prussian carp）因捕捞、运输和过度拥挤导致白细胞和血小板总数发生应激诱导的变化，以及白细胞分类比例发生变化。
text_zh: 本研究中展示的银鲫（Prussian carp）因捕捞、运输和过度拥挤导致白细胞和血小板总数发生应激诱导的变化，以及白细胞分类比例发生变化。
text_en: In this study, Prussian carp showed stress-induced changes in total white blood cell and platelet counts, as well as changes in white blood cell differential ratios, due to capture, transport, and overcrowding.

quote: Comparison and analysis in Prussian carp hematological parameters from ﬁ sh with and without exposure to stressful conditions such as capture, manipulation, transport and holding, revealed signiﬁ cant differences between stressed and non-stressed ﬁ sh.
statement: 比较暴露于捕捞、操作、运输和暂养等应激条件与未暴露的普鲁士鲤鱼血液学参数，显示应激鱼与非应激鱼之间存在显著差异。
text_zh: 比较暴露于捕捞、操作、运输和暂养等应激条件与未暴露的普鲁士鲤鱼血液学参数，显示应激鱼与非应激鱼之间存在显著差异。
text_en: Comparing haematological parameters of Prussian carp exposed to stress conditions such as capture, handling, transport and holding versus unexposed fish showed significant differences between stressed and non-stressed fish.

quote: Signiﬁ cant reduction in the total number of thrombocytes and lymphocytes and the increase in total neutrophil count were observed in stressed animals.
statement: 在受应激的动物中观察到血小板和淋巴细胞总数显著减少以及中性粒细胞总数增加。
text_zh: 在受应激的动物中观察到血小板和淋巴细胞总数显著减少以及中性粒细胞总数增加。
text_en: A significant decrease in total platelet and lymphocyte counts and an increase in total neutrophil counts were observed in stressed animals.

quote: However, differences in total leukocyte number and the number of monocytes were not observed.
statement: 然而，未观察到白细胞总数和单核细胞数量的差异。
text_zh: 然而，未观察到白细胞总数和单核细胞数量的差异。
text_en: However, no differences were observed in total white blood cell count and monocyte numbers.

quote: Deviations from the estimated reference intervals for Prussian carp hematological parameters clearly indicated the presence/absence of a stress reaction and to some extent its intensity.
statement: 偏离普鲁士鲤鱼血液学参数的估计参考区间清楚地表明了应激反应的存在/缺失及其在一定程度上强度。
text_zh: 偏离普鲁士鲤鱼血液学参数的估计参考区间清楚地表明了应激反应的存在/缺失及其在一定程度上强度。
text_en: The estimated reference intervals for the hematological parameters of Prussian carp clearly indicate the presence/absence of a stress response and its intensity to some extent.

quote: Red blood cells were collected from the caudal vein into syringes containing approximately 200-400 units of sodium heparin.
statement: 从尾静脉采集红细胞到含有约200-400单位肝素钠的注射器中。
text_zh: 从尾静脉采集红细胞到含有约200-400单位肝素钠的注射器中。
text_en: Red blood cells were collected from the tail vein into a syringe containing about 200-400 units of heparin sodium.

quote: Hematological methods are relatively simple and effective tools used in fish health assessment.
statement: 血液学方法是用于鱼类健康评估的相对简单且有效的工具。
text_zh: 血液学方法是用于鱼类健康评估的相对简单且有效的工具。
text_en: Hematological methods are a relatively simple and effective tool for fish health assessment.

quote: While leukograms can be used to indicate the presence of a disorder, in this case stress, there are definite limitations of the technique in the determination of the underlying cause of the observed abnormal findings.
statement: 虽然白细胞分类计数可用于指示疾病（此处为应激）的存在，但在确定观察到的异常发现的根本原因方面，该技术存在明确的局限性。
text_zh: 虽然白细胞分类计数可用于指示疾病（此处为应激）的存在，但在确定观察到的异常发现的根本原因方面，该技术存在明确的局限性。
text_en: Although differential white blood cell counts can be used to indicate the presence of disease (here, stress), this technique has clear limitations in determining the root cause of the observed abnormal findings.
limitations: 无法确定异常发现的根本原因

quote: The presence of acute, or sometimes chronic, stress can be detected in fish by monitoring changes in the values of hematological parameters.
statement: 通过监测血液学参数值的变化，可以检测到鱼类中急性或有时慢性的应激存在。
text_zh: 通过监测血液学参数值的变化，可以检测到鱼类中急性或有时慢性的应激存在。
text_en: By monitoring changes in hematological parameter values, the presence of acute or sometimes chronic stress in fish can be detected.

quote: Acute stress in fish and other animals is known to cause neutrophilia and lymphopenia.
statement: 已知鱼类和其他动物的急性应激会导致中性粒细胞增多和淋巴细胞减少。
text_zh: 已知鱼类和其他动物的急性应激会导致中性粒细胞增多和淋巴细胞减少。
text_en: It is known that acute stress in fish and other animals leads to neutrophilia and lymphopenia.

quote: Within the above-mentioned limitations, leukograms are used in the clinical assessment of health status and stress in fish [11].
statement: 白细胞计数图被用于评估鱼类的健康状况和应激水平。
text_zh: 白细胞计数图被用于评估鱼类的健康状况和应激水平。
text_en: Leukograms are used to assess the health status and stress levels of fish.
limitations: 存在上述提到的局限性

quote: The purpose of the present study was to characterize the changes in leukogram of Prussian carp exposed to acute stress, using cytochemical stains to improve the accuracy of blood smear counts of selected cell types (granulocytes, lymphocytes and thrombocytes).
statement: 本研究的目的是通过细胞化学染色提高选定血涂片计数的准确性，从而表征暴露于急性应激下的普鲁士鲤的白细胞计数图变化。
text_zh: 本研究的目的是通过细胞化学染色提高选定血涂片计数的准确性，从而表征暴露于急性应激下的普鲁士鲤的白细胞计数图变化。
text_en: The purpose of this study was to characterize changes in the leukocyte count profile of Prussian carp exposed to acute stress by improving the accuracy of selected blood smear counts through cytochemical staining.
outcome: 急性应激下的血液指标变化

quote: Conditions of acute or chronic stress can cause severe consequences, including decrease in production parameters and deteriorated health with increased mortalities.
statement: 急性或慢性应激条件会导致生产参数下降、健康状况恶化以及死亡率增加等严重后果。
text_zh: 急性或慢性应激条件会导致生产参数下降、健康状况恶化以及死亡率增加等严重后果。
text_en: Acute or chronic stress conditions lead to severe consequences such as decreased production parameters, deteriorated health status, and increased mortality.

quote: It is known that in well-managed ponds mortalities due to acute stress are very rare.
statement: 在管理良好的池塘中，由急性应激引起的死亡非常罕见。
text_zh: 在管理良好的池塘中，由急性应激引起的死亡非常罕见。
text_en: In well-managed ponds, deaths caused by acute stress are very rare.

quote: It is also known that chronic stress can be responsible for the increased susceptibility to diseases, metabolic changes and changes in energy utilization leading to reduced growth, suppression of the immune response, and inhibition of gonadal maturation and ovulation [1].
statement: 已知慢性应激可导致疾病易感性增加、代谢变化以及能量利用改变，进而引起生长减缓、免疫反应抑制以及性腺成熟和排卵受阻。
text_zh: 已知慢性应激可导致疾病易感性增加、代谢变化以及能量利用改变，进而引起生长减缓、免疫反应抑制以及性腺成熟和排卵受阻。
text_en: It is known that chronic stress can lead to increased susceptibility to disease, metabolic changes, and altered energy utilization, thereby causing reduced growth, suppressed immune responses, and impaired gonadal maturation and ovulation.
outcome: 疾病易感性与免疫反应

quote: Prussian carp has been shown to both have resilience and be responsive to different external factors that can lead to increased stress.
statement: 已证明银鲫既具有恢复力，又会对导致压力增加的多种外部因素作出反应。
text_zh: 已证明银鲫既具有恢复力，又会对导致压力增加的多种外部因素作出反应。
text_en: Silver crucian carp have been shown to possess resilience and to respond to multiple external factors that cause increased stress.

quote: The absolute number of neutrophil leukocytes in Prussian carps that were not exposed to stress was signiﬁ cantly lower compared to stressed ﬁ sh (p < 0.01), indicating acute neutrophilia in Prussian carps exposed to stress factors.
statement: 未暴露于应激的普鲁士鲤鱼的嗜中性粒细胞绝对数显著低于受激鱼，表明暴露于应激因素的普鲁士鲤鱼出现急性嗜中性粒细胞增多症。
text_zh: 未暴露于应激的普鲁士鲤鱼的嗜中性粒细胞绝对数显著低于受激鱼，表明暴露于应激因素的普鲁士鲤鱼出现急性嗜中性粒细胞增多症。
text_en: The absolute neutrophil count in unexposed Prussian carp was significantly lower than that of stressed fish, indicating acute neutrophilia in Prussian carp exposed to stress factors.
outcome: 免疫细胞反应（嗜中性粒细胞）

quote:
Concurrently, statistically
signiﬁ cant lymphopenia in Prussian carp was observed in stressed ﬁ sh (p < 0.01).
statement: 同时，在受压的普鲁士鲤鱼中观察到统计学上显著的淋巴细胞减少症。
text_zh: 同时，在受压的普鲁士鲤鱼中观察到统计学上显著的淋巴细胞减少症。
text_en: At the same time, statistically significant lymphopenia was observed in stressed Prussian carp.

quote:
Monocytes showed no statistically
signiﬁ cant change between Prussian carp that were
not exposed to stress factors compared to those exposed to stress factors (p>0.05)
statement: 与未暴露于应激因素的普鲁士鲤鱼相比，暴露于应激因素的普鲁士鲤鱼的单核细胞没有统计学上的显著变化。
text_zh: 与未暴露于应激因素的普鲁士鲤鱼相比，暴露于应激因素的普鲁士鲤鱼的单核细胞没有统计学上的显著变化。
text_en: Compared to Prussian carp not exposed to stress factors, monocytes of Prussian carp exposed to stress factors showed no statistically significant change.

quote: The fish were anesthetized using buffered solution of tricaine-methane-sulfonate (pH 7.4; MS-222, Sigma, St. Louis, Missouri, USA) at a concentration of 75 mg/L for 2 minutes.
statement: Fish were anesthetized with a buffered solution of tricaine-methane-sulfonate (MS-222) at 75 mg/L for 2 minutes.
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with a buffered solution of tricaine-methane-sulfonate (MS-222) at 75 mg/L for 2 minutes.

quote: Blood samples were collected from all sampled and anesthetized fish by caudal vein puncture immediately after capture.
statement: Blood samples were collected via caudal vein puncture immediately after capture while the fish were anesthetized.
text_en: Blood samples were collected via caudal vein puncture immediately after capture while the fish were anesthetized.

quote: The procedure of blood sampling and making blood smears lasted <2 minutes per fish.
statement: The combined procedure of blood sampling and smear preparation took less than 2 minutes per fish.
text_en: The combined procedure of blood sampling and smear preparation took less than 2 minutes per fish.

quote: fish placed in aquaria with strong aeration, simulating prolonged transport conditions.
statement: Fish were placed in aquaria with strong aeration to simulate prolonged transport conditions.
text_en: Fish were placed in aquaria with strong aeration to simulate prolonged transport conditions.

quote: Following anesthesia for blood collection, fish were killed by an overdose of anesthetic (1 g L-1 of buffered tricaine-methyl-sulfonate solution, MS222, Sigma, Germany) followed by a sharp blow on the head [14].
statement: Fish were euthanized by an overdose of MS-222 (1 g/L) followed by a sharp blow to the head.
text_en: Fish were euthanized by an overdose of MS-222 (1 g/L) followed by a sharp blow to the head.

quote: During the clinical examination carried out during ﬁ sh collection non-speciﬁ c symptoms of disease such as gathering of ﬁ sh at the water inlet/outlet, lethargy, swimming in unnatural positions, resting at the pond bottom or rapid fatigue, were not observed.
statement: 在鱼类采集期间进行的临床检查中，未观察到非特异性疾病症状，如鱼群聚集在进水口/出水口、嗜睡、以不自然姿势游泳、停留在池塘底部或快速疲劳。
text_zh: 在鱼类采集期间进行的临床检查中，未观察到非特异性疾病症状，如鱼群聚集在进水口/出水口、嗜睡、以不自然姿势游泳、停留在池塘底部或快速疲劳。
text_en: During clinical examinations conducted during fish collection, no non-specific disease symptoms were observed, such as fish aggregating at the inlet/outlet, lethargy, swimming in unnatural postures, staying at the bottom of the pond, or rapid fatigue.

quote: Non-stressed control is set as 100% (n=10). Error bars represent standard error and asterisks represent signiﬁ cant difference (*p<0.01;**p <0.05)
statement: 非应激对照组设定为100%，误差棒代表标准误，星号表示显著性差异。
text_zh: 非应激对照组设定为100%，误差棒代表标准误，星号表示显著性差异。
text_en: The non-stressed control group was set to 100%, error bars represent the standard error, and asterisks indicate significant differences.

quote: Total number of leukocytes between Prussian carp that were not exposed to stress factors compared to those exposed to stress was not signiﬁ cantly different (p>0.05), which indicated that the leukopenia (reduction of the total number of leukocytes, not including thrombocytes) in Prussian carp that were exposed to stress factors is not readily observable.
statement: 暴露于应激因素的普鲁士鲤鱼与未暴露者相比，白细胞总数无显著差异，表明其白细胞减少症不易观察到。
text_zh: 暴露于应激因素的普鲁士鲤鱼与未暴露者相比，白细胞总数无显著差异，表明其白细胞减少症不易观察到。
text_en: The total white blood cell count of Prussian carp exposed to stress factors showed no significant difference compared to unexposed individuals, indicating that their leukopenia is not easily observable.
outcome: 免疫细胞数量（白细胞总数）

quote: However, contrary to this ﬁ nding, the same test proved a statistically signiﬁ cant decrease in the total number of thrombocytes (signiﬁ cant thrombocytopenia) in Prussian carp who were exposed to stress, compared to those who were not exposed to stress factors (p < 0.01)
statement: 与未暴露于应激因素的个体相比，暴露于应激的普鲁士鲤鱼的血小板总数出现统计学上显著的下降（显著的血小板减少症）。
text_zh: 与未暴露于应激因素的个体相比，暴露于应激的普鲁士鲤鱼的血小板总数出现统计学上显著的下降（显著的血小板减少症）。
text_en: Compared to individuals not exposed to stressors, the total platelet count in stressed Prussian carp showed a statistically significant decrease (significant thrombocytopenia).
outcome: 免疫/血液细胞数量（血小板）

quote: A statistically signiﬁ cant increase in the percentage of neutrophil leukocytes (p<0.01) can be observed (*), as well as a statistically signiﬁ cant (p<0.05) decrease in the percentage of lymphocytes and thrombocytes in Prussian carp exposed to stress compared to Prussian carp that were not exposed to stress (**).
statement: 与未受胁迫的普鲁士鲤鱼相比，暴露于胁迫的普鲁士鲤鱼的嗜中性粒细胞百分比显著增加，而淋巴细胞和血栓细胞的百分比显著降低。
text_zh: 与未受胁迫的普鲁士鲤鱼相比，暴露于胁迫的普鲁士鲤鱼的嗜中性粒细胞百分比显著增加，而淋巴细胞和血栓细胞的百分比显著降低。
text_en: Compared to unstressed Prussian carp, the percentage of neutrophils significantly increased in stressed Prussian carp, while the percentages of lymphocytes and thrombocytes significantly decreased.
outcome: 免疫细胞相对丰度变化

quote: No statistically signiﬁ cant difference was found in the percentage of monocytes (p>0.05) (C).
statement: 在暴露于胁迫与未暴露于胁迫的普鲁士鲤鱼之间，单核细胞的百分比没有发现统计学上的显著差异。
text_zh: 在暴露于胁迫与未暴露于胁迫的普鲁士鲤鱼之间，单核细胞的百分比没有发现统计学上的显著差异。
text_en: No statistically significant difference was found in the percentage of monocytes between Prussian carp exposed to stress and those not exposed to stress.
outcome: 免疫细胞相对丰度变化

quote: There are no clear tendencies of changes in the total number of thrombocytes in ﬁ sh exposed to different stress factors.
statement: 暴露于不同应激因素的鱼类中，血小板总数的变化没有明确的趋势。
text_zh: 暴露于不同应激因素的鱼类中，血小板总数的变化没有明确的趋势。
text_en: In fish exposed to different stress factors, there was no clear trend in the change of total platelet count.

quote: Under the inﬂ uence of various stress factors, blood coagulation is often accelerated, but this is not always accompanied by an increase in the total number of thrombocytes.
statement: 在各种应激因素的影响下，血液凝固通常会加速，但这并不总是伴随着血小板总数的增加。
text_zh: 在各种应激因素的影响下，血液凝固通常会加速，但这并不总是伴随着血小板总数的增加。
text_en: Under the influence of various stress factors, blood coagulation usually accelerates, but this is not always accompanied by an increase in total platelet count.
outcome: 凝血功能与血小板数量

quote: Contrary to this ﬁ nding, different stress factors signiﬁ cantly affect the increase in the number of thrombocytes in the peripheral blood of channel catﬁ sh [24].
statement: 与此发现相反，不同的应激因素显著影响斑点叉尾鮰外周血中血小板数量的增加。
text_zh: 与此发现相反，不同的应激因素显著影响斑点叉尾鮰外周血中血小板数量的增加。
text_en: Contrary to this finding, different stress factors significantly affected the increase in platelet count in the peripheral blood of channel catfish.

quote:
consequences of stress can be observed for a few days after
the removal of stressors [4].
statement: 压力后果在去除应激源后几天内仍可观察到。
text_zh: 压力后果在去除应激源后几天内仍可观察到。
text_en: Stress consequences can still be observed for several days after the stressor is removed.

quote:
Differences in total white blood cell counts can be attributed to many factors, both
biotic (such as age, gender, sexual maturity, pathogens) and abiotic (water temperature,
pH, dissolved oxygen content, season).
statement: 白细胞总数的差异可归因于许多生物因素（如年龄、性别、性成熟度、病原体）和非生物因素（水温、pH值、溶解氧含量、季节）。
text_zh: 白细胞总数的差异可归因于许多生物因素（如年龄、性别、性成熟度、病原体）和非生物因素（水温、pH值、溶解氧含量、季节）。
text_en: Differences in total white blood cell count can be attributed to many biological factors (such as age, sex, sexual maturity, pathogens) and abiotic factors (water temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen content, season).

quote: According to the anamnestic data collected, the ﬁ sh had a good appetite and were within expected production parameters.
statement: 根据收集的病史数据，这些鱼食欲良好，且处于预期的生产参数范围内。
text_zh: 根据收集的病史数据，这些鱼食欲良好，且处于预期的生产参数范围内。
text_en: Based on the collected history data, these fish had good appetite and were within the expected production parameter range.

quote: All captured ﬁ sh survived the transport to the laboratory.
statement: 所有捕获的鱼在运输到实验室的过程中均存活。
text_zh: 所有捕获的鱼在运输到实验室的过程中均存活。
text_en: All captured fish survived during transport to the laboratory.

quote: External examination of ﬁ sh arriving at the laboratory revealed no obvious signs of illness (wounds, visible secondary bacterial and fungal infections, and cachexia).
statement: 对到达实验室的鱼进行外部检查未发现明显的疾病迹象（伤口、可见的继发性细菌和真菌感染以及恶病质）。
text_zh: 对到达实验室的鱼进行外部检查未发现明显的疾病迹象（伤口、可见的继发性细菌和真菌感染以及恶病质）。
text_en: External examination of the fish upon arrival at the laboratory revealed no obvious signs of disease (wounds, visible secondary bacterial and fungal infections, and cachexia).

quote: Necropsy of the specimens after second blood drawing did not reveal any gross signs of disease.
statement: 第二次采血后的尸体解剖未发现任何肉眼可见的疾病迹象。
text_zh: 第二次采血后的尸体解剖未发现任何肉眼可见的疾病迹象。
text_en: Necropsy after the second blood sampling did not reveal any visible signs of disease.

quote: No antibiotics were used throughout the disease outbreak in the crucian carp pond.
statement: 在鲫鱼池塘的疾病暴发期间未使用抗生素。
text_zh: 在鲫鱼池塘的疾病暴发期间未使用抗生素。
text_en: No antibiotics were used during the disease outbreak in crucian carp ponds.

quote: To minimize distress and ensure animal welfare during the challenge experiment, fish were anesthetized and handled in an immersion bath containing 50 mg/L ethyl 3-aminobenzoate methane sulfonate.
statement: 为了在攻毒实验期间最大限度地减少痛苦并确保动物福利，鱼在含有50 mg/L甲磺酸乙酯氨基苯甲酸（MS-222）的浸泡浴中被麻醉和处理。
text_zh: 为了在攻毒实验期间最大限度地减少痛苦并确保动物福利，鱼在含有50 mg/L甲磺酸乙酯氨基苯甲酸（MS-222）的浸泡浴中被麻醉和处理。
text_en: To minimize suffering and ensure animal welfare during the challenge experiment, fish were anesthetized and handled in a bath containing 50 mg/L ethyl aminobenzoate methanesulfonate (MS-222).

quote: Flavobacterium psychrophilum is a Gram-negative bacterium that acts as a primary etiological agent of bacterial cold-water disease (BCWD) in salmonid fish.
statement: 嗜冷黄杆菌是鲑科鱼类细菌性冷水病的主要病原体。
text_zh: 嗜冷黄杆菌是鲑科鱼类细菌性冷水病的主要病原体。
text_en: Flavobacterium psychrophilum is the main pathogen of bacterial cold water disease in salmonid fish.

quote: In the past 5 years, this pathogen has also been isolated from multiple freshwater fish species in China, including crucian carp (Carassius auratus gibelio), grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idellus) and silver carp (Hypophthalmichthys molitrix), and identified as the causal agent of overwintering mortality syndrome.
statement: 过去五年中，该病原体也在中国多种淡水鱼（包括鲫鱼、草鱼和鲢鱼）中被分离出来，并被确定为越冬死亡综合征的致病因子。
text_zh: 过去五年中，该病原体也在中国多种淡水鱼（包括鲫鱼、草鱼和鲢鱼）中被分离出来，并被确定为越冬死亡综合征的致病因子。
text_en: Over the past five years, this pathogen has also been isolated from various freshwater fish in China (including crucian carp, grass carp and silver carp) and identified as the causative agent of winter mortality syndrome.

population.species: crucian carp; grass carp; silver carp

quote: The characteristic mark of the stress-leukogram in ﬁ sh is lymphopenia and neutrophilia [51,52].
statement: 鱼类应激性白细胞图谱的特征是淋巴细胞减少和中性粒细胞增多。
text_zh: 鱼类应激性白细胞图谱的特征是淋巴细胞减少和中性粒细胞增多。
text_en: The stress leukogram in fish is characterized by lymphopenia and neutrophilia.

quote: The results obtained in our research are in accordance with the results of these authors, and are in the contrary to studies claiming that t the numbers of circulating lymphocytes and neutrophils remain unchanged after exposure to stress [30].
statement: 本研究结果与上述作者一致，但与声称暴露于应激后循环淋巴细胞和中性粒细胞数量保持不变的研究相反。
text_zh: 本研究结果与上述作者一致，但与声称暴露于应激后循环淋巴细胞和中性粒细胞数量保持不变的研究相反。
text_en: The results of this study are consistent with the aforementioned authors, but contrary to studies claiming that circulating lymphocyte and neutrophil numbers remain unchanged after exposure to stress.
counterevidence: 有研究声称应激后细胞数量不变

quote: Changes in the total number of circulating leukocytes, their redistribution and quantitative shifts within the leukocyte formula are the most frequently observed effects in ﬁ sh exposed to stress.
statement: 循环白细胞总数的变化、重新分布以及白细胞分类中的定量偏移是暴露于应激的鱼类中最常观察到的效应。
text_zh: 循环白细胞总数的变化、重新分布以及白细胞分类中的定量偏移是暴露于应激的鱼类中最常观察到的效应。
text_en: Changes in total circulating leukocyte counts, redistribution, and quantitative shifts in the leukocyte differential are the most commonly observed effects in fish exposed to stress.

quote: Flavobacterium psychrophilum is the etiological agent of overwintering mortality syndrome in conventional freshwater fish and rainbow trout fry syndrome in salmonid aquaculture (Nematollahi et al., 2003 ; Jiang et al., 2024), causing substantial losses at low-water temperatures.
statement: 嗜冷黄杆菌是常规淡水鱼越冬死亡综合征和鲑科养殖中虹鳟苗种综合征的病原体，在低温下造成重大损失。
text_zh: 嗜冷黄杆菌是常规淡水鱼越冬死亡综合征和鲑科养殖中虹鳟苗种综合征的病原体，在低温下造成重大损失。
text_en: Flavobacterium psychrophilum is the pathogen of overwintering mortality syndrome in conventional freshwater fish and fry syndrome in salmonid aquaculture, causing significant losses at low temperatures.

quote: An outbreak of overwintering mortality syndrome in Jiangsu Province, China, was subsequently attributed to F. psychrophilum , marking the first identification of this pathogen in crucian carp (Jiang et al., 2024).
statement: 中国江苏省越冬死亡综合症的爆发被归因于嗜冷黄杆菌，标志着该病原体在鲫鱼中的首次鉴定。
text_zh: 中国江苏省越冬死亡综合症的爆发被归因于嗜冷黄杆菌，标志着该病原体在鲫鱼中的首次鉴定。
text_en: The outbreak of winter mortality syndrome in Jiangsu Province, China, was attributed to Flavobacterium psychrophilum, marking the first identification of this pathogen in crucian carp.

quote: These findings provide novel insights into F. psychrophilum evolution and host-pathogen interactions and support future efforts to manage overwintering mortality syndrome in conventional freshwater fish.
statement: 这些发现为弗氏柱状病的进化和宿主-病原体相互作用提供了新的见解，并支持未来管理常规淡水鱼越冬死亡综合征的努力。
text_zh: 这些发现为弗氏柱状病的进化和宿主-病原体相互作用提供了新的见解，并支持未来管理常规淡水鱼越冬死亡综合征的努力。
text_en: These findings provide new insights into the evolution and host-pathogen interactions of Flavobacterium columnare disease, and support future efforts to manage overwintering mortality syndrome in conventional freshwater fish.
intervention_record: 基于基因组的管理策略

quote: Practically, NJ01′s susceptibility profile may guide overwintering mortality syndrome treatment in conventional freshwater fish.
statement: NJ01菌株的药敏谱可能指导常规淡水鱼越冬死亡综合征的治疗。
text_zh: NJ01菌株的药敏谱可能指导常规淡水鱼越冬死亡综合征的治疗。
text_en: The antimicrobial susceptibility profile of strain NJ01 may guide the treatment of overwintering mortality syndrome in conventional freshwater fish.
limitations: 数据来源于实验室条件下的体外测试，且基于单一分离株。

quote: Phage therapy against Flavobacterium psychrophilum focusing on phage distribution and host health implications in rainbow trout fry.
statement: 噬菌体疗法针对嗜冷黄杆菌，重点关注其在虹鳟鱼苗中的分布及对宿主健康的影响。
text_zh: 噬菌体疗法针对嗜冷黄杆菌，重点关注其在虹鳟鱼苗中的分布及对宿主健康的影响。
text_en: Phage therapy targeting Flavobacterium psychrophilum, focusing on its distribution in rainbow trout fry and its impact on host health.

quote: Stress-induced hematological changes depend on type of stressor, its magnitude and time of action [42].
statement: 应激诱导的血液学变化取决于应激源的类型、强度和作用时间。
text_zh: 应激诱导的血液学变化取决于应激源的类型、强度和作用时间。
text_en: Stress-induced hematological changes depend on the type, intensity, and duration of the stressor.

quote: Short-term stress sometimes results in an increase in WBC but chronic and/or strong stress usually causes leukopenia [44].
statement: 短期应激有时导致白细胞增加，但慢性和/或强烈应激通常引起白细胞减少。
text_zh: 短期应激有时导致白细胞增加，但慢性和/或强烈应激通常引起白细胞减少。
text_en: Short-term stress sometimes leads to an increase in white blood cells, but chronic and/or severe stress usually causes a decrease in white blood cells.

quote: In the course of our research, we found out that the total number of leukocytes in the peripheral blood of Prussian carp exposed to stress factors was only slightly lower compared to the values of the group of ﬁ sh that were not exposed to stress.
statement: 研究发现，暴露于应激因素的普鲁士鲤鱼外周血中白细胞总数仅略低于未暴露组。
text_zh: 研究发现，暴露于应激因素的普鲁士鲤鱼外周血中白细胞总数仅略低于未暴露组。
text_en: The study found that the total white blood cell count in the peripheral blood of Prussian carp exposed to stress factors was only slightly lower than that of the unexposed group.

quote: A tendency to increase the total number of leukocytes may indicate an increased protective function of blood in the body of the Prussian carp under the stress as action of chemical toxicants [45].
statement: 白细胞总数增加的趋势可能表明在化学毒物引起的应激下，普鲁士鲤鱼的血液保护功能增强。
text_zh: 白细胞总数增加的趋势可能表明在化学毒物引起的应激下，普鲁士鲤鱼的血液保护功能增强。
text_en: The trend of an increase in total white blood cell count may indicate enhanced blood protection function in Prussian carp under stress caused by chemical toxins.

quote: Differential leukocyte counts belong to important characteristics of the health state of ﬁ sh and in many cases they are also helpful in evaluating the immune system and variations in the proportion of these cells are considered normal [9].
statement: 白细胞分类计数属于鱼类健康状态的重要特征，在许多情况下有助于评估免疫系统，这些细胞比例的变化被认为是正常的。
text_zh: 白细胞分类计数属于鱼类健康状态的重要特征，在许多情况下有助于评估免疫系统，这些细胞比例的变化被认为是正常的。
text_en: White blood cell differential counts are an important characteristic of fish health status and help assess the immune system in many cases; changes in these cell proportions are considered normal.

quote: The neutrophils and lymphocytes numbers are affected by stress in opposite directions [46].
statement: 中性粒细胞和淋巴细胞的数量受应激的影响方向相反。
text_zh: 中性粒细胞和淋巴细胞的数量受应激的影响方向相反。
text_en: The number of neutrophils and lymphocytes is affected by stress in opposite directions.

quote: Such changes may persist for several days after the stressor is removed [11].
statement: 这种变化可能在去除应激源后持续数天。
text_zh: 这种变化可能在去除应激源后持续数天。
text_en: This change may persist for several days after the removal of the stressor.

quote: Fish treatments were carried out according to the recommendations in the Guidelines for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals of the National Advisory Committee for Laboratory Animal Research in China and approved by the Animal Care Committee of Hunan Normal University(Permit Number: 4237).
statement: 鱼类处理遵循中国实验动物国家咨询委员会的指南，并获得了湖南师范大学动物护理委员会的批准。
text_zh: 鱼类处理遵循中国实验动物国家咨询委员会的指南，并获得了湖南师范大学动物护理委员会的批准。
text_en: Fish handling followed the guidelines of the National Advisory Committee for Laboratory Animal Research in China and was approved by the Animal Care Committee of Hunan Normal University.

quote: These findings reinforce the importance of antimicrobial stewardship: therapeutic decisions should be guided by strain-specific susceptibility testing to reduce selective pressure and limit the emergence of resistance (Sørum, 2005 ; Gazal et al., 2020).
statement: 这些发现强调了抗菌药物管理的重要性：治疗决策应基于特定菌株的药敏试验，以减少选择压力并限制耐药性的出现。
text_zh: 这些发现强调了抗菌药物管理的重要性：治疗决策应基于特定菌株的药敏试验，以减少选择压力并限制耐药性的出现。
text_en: These findings emphasize the importance of antimicrobial stewardship: treatment decisions should be based on susceptibility testing for specific strains to reduce selection pressure and limit the emergence of resistance.
intervention_record: 基于药敏的抗菌药管理

quote: Studies have investigated whether thrombocytes in some ﬁ sh have phagocytic abilities [24,25,29,32,36].
statement: 已有研究调查了某些鱼类的血小板是否具有吞噬能力。
text_zh: 已有研究调查了某些鱼类的血小板是否具有吞噬能力。
text_en: Existing studies have investigated whether the platelets of certain fish species possess phagocytic ability.

quote: All samples were cultured in open pools (0.067 ha) with suitable pH (7.0-8.5), water temperature (22-24°C), dissolved oxygen content (5.0-8.0 mg/L) and adequate forage at the State Key Laboratory of Developmental Biology of Freshwater Fish, Hunan Normal University, China.
statement: 所有样本在开放池塘中养殖，维持适宜的pH值、水温、溶解氧含量和充足的饵料。
text_zh: 所有样本在开放池塘中养殖，维持适宜的pH值、水温、溶解氧含量和充足的饵料。
text_en: All samples were reared in open ponds, maintaining suitable pH, water temperature, dissolved oxygen content, and adequate feed.

quote: All fish were anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich, St Louis, MO, USA) before blood collection.
statement: 在采血前，所有鱼均使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在采血前，所有鱼均使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉。
text_en: Before blood sampling, all fish were anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222.

quote: Before dissection, the experimental fish were anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich St. Louis MO USA), and the brains of diploid and triploid Carassius auratus were removed under sterile conditions.
statement: 解剖前，实验鱼使用100 mg/L的MS-222麻醉，并在无菌条件下移除二倍体和三倍体鲫鱼的脑部。
text_zh: 解剖前，实验鱼使用100 mg/L的MS-222麻醉，并在无菌条件下移除二倍体和三倍体鲫鱼的脑部。
text_en: Before dissection, experimental fish were anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222, and the brains of diploid and triploid crucian carp were removed under sterile conditions.

quote: In this study, the F. psychrophilum strain NJ01 was successfully isolated from overwintering mortality syndrome in conventional freshwater fish in China.
statement: 在本研究中，从中国的常规淡水鱼越冬死亡综合征中成功分离出嗜冷黄杆菌NJ01菌株。
text_zh: 在本研究中，从中国的常规淡水鱼越冬死亡综合征中成功分离出嗜冷黄杆菌NJ01菌株。
text_en: In this study, the Flavobacterium psychrophilum NJ01 strain was successfully isolated from conventional freshwater fish winter mortality syndrome in China.

quote: There is currently a lack of systematic research data on the field performance of the corresponding antibiotics against F. psychrophilum in complex aquaculture environments, as well as their ecological safety and residue risks.
statement: 目前缺乏关于相应抗生素在复杂养殖环境中针对F. psychrophilum的现场表现以及其生态安全性和残留风险的系统研究数据。
text_zh: 目前缺乏关于相应抗生素在复杂养殖环境中针对F. psychrophilum的现场表现以及其生态安全性和残留风险的系统研究数据。
text_en: There is currently a lack of systematic research data on the field performance of corresponding antibiotics against F. psychrophilum in complex aquaculture environments, as well as their ecological safety and residue risks.
counterevidence: 现场表现、生态安全性和残留风险未知

quote: More targeted and environmentally friendly biocontrol technologies, such as phage therapy (Donati et al., 2021), have made significant progress and demonstrate considerable application potential.
statement: 更具针对性和环保的生物防治技术，如噬菌体疗法，已取得显著进展并显示出巨大的应用潜力。
text_zh: 更具针对性和环保的生物防治技术，如噬菌体疗法，已取得显著进展并显示出巨大的应用潜力。
text_en: More targeted and environmentally friendly biological control technologies, such as phage therapy, have made significant progress and shown great application potential.
outcome: 疾病控制与环境友好性

quote: Study by Cialini et al. (2025) have shown that the phage therapy can effectively reduce the risk of F. psychrophilum invasion by specifically recognizing and lysing.
statement: Cialini等人（2025）的研究表明，噬菌体疗法可以通过特异性识别和裂解来有效降低F. psychrophilum入侵的风险。
text_zh: Cialini等人（2025）的研究表明，噬菌体疗法可以通过特异性识别和裂解来有效降低F. psychrophilum入侵的风险。
text_en: The study by Cialini et al. (2025) indicates that phage therapy can effectively reduce the risk of F. psychrophilum invasion through specific recognition and lysis.

quote: In the future, exploring green and integrated control systems is expected to represent a safer, more efficient, and fundamental direction for controlling this disease.
statement: 未来，探索绿色综合防控体系预计将成为控制该疾病更安全、更高效且根本的方向。
text_zh: 未来，探索绿色综合防控体系预计将成为控制该疾病更安全、更高效且根本的方向。
text_en: In the future, exploring a green comprehensive prevention and control system is expected to become a safer, more efficient, and fundamental direction for controlling this disease.
outcome: 疾病控制安全性与效率

quote: Pb exposure rapidly increased the abundance of pathogenic bacteria, leading to intestinal disorders, further aggravating the damage of Pb to intestinal structure and function.
statement: 铅暴露迅速增加了致病菌的丰度，导致肠道紊乱，进一步加剧了铅对肠道结构和功能的损害。
text_zh: 铅暴露迅速增加了致病菌的丰度，导致肠道紊乱，进一步加剧了铅对肠道结构和功能的损害。
text_en: Lead exposure rapidly increased the abundance of pathogenic bacteria, leading to intestinal disorder, which further aggravated lead-induced damage to intestinal structure and function.

quote: intestinal flora dysbiosis, morphological disruption, oxidative stress, and immune injury are involved in the toxic damage of Pb exposure to the intestinal structure and function of crucian carp.
statement: 肠道菌群失调、形态破坏、氧化应激和免疫损伤参与了铅暴露对鲫鱼肠道结构和功能的毒性损害。
text_zh: 肠道菌群失调、形态破坏、氧化应激和免疫损伤参与了铅暴露对鲫鱼肠道结构和功能的毒性损害。
text_en: Gut microbiota dysbiosis, morphological damage, oxidative stress and immune injury are involved in the toxic damage to the intestinal structure and function of crucian carp caused by lead exposure.
outcome: 肠道结构与功能完整性

quote: Pb exposure has great toxic effects on the physiological, behavioral, and biochemical functions of animals.
statement: 铅暴露对动物的生理、行为和生化功能具有巨大的毒性作用。
text_zh: 铅暴露对动物的生理、行为和生化功能具有巨大的毒性作用。
text_en: Lead exposure has huge toxic effects on the physiological, behavioral and biochemical functions of animals.

quote: Previous studies have shown that Pb causes the accumulation of heavy metals, histopathology, and neurotoxicity in fish
statement: 先前的研究表明，铅会导致鱼类体内重金属积累、组织病理学改变和神经毒性。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，铅会导致鱼类体内重金属积累、组织病理学改变和神经毒性。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that lead causes heavy metal accumulation, histopathological changes and neurotoxicity in fish.
outcome: 组织病理学与神经毒性

quote: Lead accumulation can also cause oxidative stress in aquatic organisms and damage the antioxidant function of the body
statement: 铅积累还会导致水生生物产生氧化应激并损害机体的抗氧化功能。
text_zh: 铅积累还会导致水生生物产生氧化应激并损害机体的抗氧化功能。
text_en: Lead accumulation also causes oxidative stress in aquatic organisms and damages the body's antioxidant function.
outcome: 氧化应激与抗氧化功能

quote: In this study, crucian carp were exposed to simulated ponds with added lead contamination sources.
statement: 本研究将鲫鱼暴露于添加了铅污染源模拟池塘中。
text_zh: 本研究将鲫鱼暴露于添加了铅污染源模拟池塘中。
text_en: This study exposed crucian carp to simulated ponds with added lead pollution sources.

quote: We used inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS), histopathological symptom observation, and quantitative qPCR analysis to investigate the bioaccumulation levels of lead in the fish intestine, intestinal structural damage, and the expression levels of immune and antioxidant factors.
statement: 研究使用电感耦合等离子体质谱法、组织病理学症状观察和定量qPCR分析来调查鱼肠道中的铅生物积累水平、肠道结构损伤以及免疫和抗氧化因子的表达水平。
text_zh: 研究使用电感耦合等离子体质谱法、组织病理学症状观察和定量qPCR分析来调查鱼肠道中的铅生物积累水平、肠道结构损伤以及免疫和抗氧化因子的表达水平。
text_en: The study used inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry, histopathological symptom observation, and quantitative qPCR analysis to investigate lead bioaccumulation levels, intestinal structural damage, and the expression levels of immune and antioxidant factors in fish intestines.
outcome: 生理生化指标与健康状态评估

quote: In addition, the dynamics of the fish intestinal microbiota were detected by using 16s high-throughput sequencing technology to provide a detailed analysis report on the response of crucian carp to Pb stress.
statement: 此外，利用16S高通量测序技术检测了鱼类肠道微生物群落的动态变化，以提供关于鲫鱼对铅胁迫反应的详细分析报告。
text_zh: 此外，利用16S高通量测序技术检测了鱼类肠道微生物群落的动态变化，以提供关于鲫鱼对铅胁迫反应的详细分析报告。
text_en: In addition, 16S high-throughput sequencing technology was used to detect dynamic changes in the fish intestinal microbial community, to provide a detailed analysis report on the response of crucian carp to lead stress.

quote: The relative abundance of Erysipelotrichaceae was significantly decreased to the lowest level in the J 48 h group (down to 0.52-fold, P Figure 4B), while the abundance of Vibrionaceae, Weeksellaceae, and Flavobacteriaceae was significantly increased to the highest level in the J 6 h group (up to 2.29-fold, P P P Figures 4C – E).
statement: 在J 48 h组中，丹毒丝菌科（Erysipelotrichaceae）的相对丰度显著降低至最低水平；而在J 6 h组中，弧菌科（Vibrionaceae）、威克斯氏菌科（Weeksellaceae）和黄杆菌科（Flavobacteriaceae）的丰度显著增加至最高水平。
text_zh: 在J 48 h组中，丹毒丝菌科（Erysipelotrichaceae）的相对丰度显著降低至最低水平；而在J 6 h组中，弧菌科（Vibrionaceae）、威克斯氏菌科（Weeksellaceae）和黄杆菌科（Flavobacteriaceae）的丰度显著增加至最高水平。
text_en: In the J 48 h group, the relative abundance of Erysipelotrichaceae significantly decreased to its lowest level; while in the J 6 h group, the abundances of Vibrionaceae, Weeksellaceae, and Flavobacteriaceae significantly increased to their highest levels.

text_zh: 与0小时相比，6小时、48小时和96小时的综合生物标志物响应（IBR）指数分别为4.80、16.07和31.11。
text_en: Compared with 0 hours, the Integrated Biomarker Response (IBR) index at 6, 48, and 96 hours was 4.80, 16.07, and 31.11, respectively.

quote: Before the Pb exposure experiment, acclimation was performed as usual for 2 weeks (Liu et al., 2021).
statement: 在铅暴露实验前，进行了为期2周的常规驯化。
text_zh: 在铅暴露实验前，进行了为期2周的常规驯化。
text_en: A 2-week routine acclimation was conducted prior to the lead exposure experiment.

quote: Then, Pb(NO 3) 2 was added to make the Pb concentration in the culture water reach SC (21.66 mg/L) and maintained during the experiment.
statement: 向培养水中添加硝酸铅使铅浓度达到安全浓度（21.66 mg/L），并在实验期间维持该浓度。
text_zh: 向培养水中添加硝酸铅使铅浓度达到安全浓度（21.66 mg/L），并在实验期间维持该浓度。
text_en: Lead nitrate was added to the culture water to achieve a lead concentration of the safe concentration (21.66 mg/L), and this concentration was maintained during the experiment.
outcome: 重金属污染与健康风险

quote: Fish were anesthetized with 0.05% tricaine methane sulfonate (MS-222; Aladdin, China) before sampling.
statement: 采样前使用0.05%三甲基磺酸甲烷（MS-222）对鱼进行麻醉。
text_zh: 采样前使用0.05%三甲基磺酸甲烷（MS-222）对鱼进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with 0.05% methanesulfonic acid trimethylamine (MS-222) before sampling.

quote: The intestine of crucian carp was fixed with Bouin's solution, embedded in paraffin, sectioned at 4 μm thickness, and stained with hematoxylin and eosin (HE). Finally, the intestinal tissue was observed under a polarized light microscope (Leica, Germany) (Tan et al., 2018).
statement: Crucian carp intestines were processed for histopathological examination via fixation, embedding, sectioning, HE staining, and microscopic observation.
text_en: Crucian carp intestines were processed for histopathological examination via fixation, embedding, sectioning, HE staining, and microscopic observation.

quote: Based on the pathway comparison analysis of Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), the influence of intestinal microbiota change on the intestinal function of crucian carp were predicted.
statement: 基于KEGG通路比较分析，预测了肠道微生物群变化对鲫鱼肠道功能的影响。
text_zh: 基于KEGG通路比较分析，预测了肠道微生物群变化对鲫鱼肠道功能的影响。
text_en: Based on KEGG pathway comparative analysis, the impact of gut microbiota changes on intestinal function in crucian carp was predicted.

quote: At the level 2, membrane transport and the immune system function were significantly changed after Pb exposure
statement: 在二级水平上，铅暴露后膜转运和免疫系统功能发生显著变化。
text_zh: 在二级水平上，铅暴露后膜转运和免疫系统功能发生显著变化。
text_en: At the secondary level, significant changes occurred in membrane transport and immune system function after lead exposure.

quote: After Pb exposure, the relative abundance of peroxisome and PPAR signaling pathway functions in the intestine increased significantly, while membrane transport and immune system decreased significantly.
statement: 铅暴露后，肠道中过氧化物酶体和PPAR信号通路功能的相对丰度显著增加，而膜转运和免疫系统显著降低。
text_zh: 铅暴露后，肠道中过氧化物酶体和PPAR信号通路功能的相对丰度显著增加，而膜转运和免疫系统显著降低。
text_en: After lead exposure, the relative abundance of peroxisome and PPAR signaling pathway functions in the gut significantly increased, while membrane transport and immune system functions significantly decreased.

quote: In this study, crucian carp (Carassius auratus) were exposed to waterborne Pb for 96 h; then, histopathological analysis, quantitative qPCR analysis, and 16S high-throughput sequencing were performed to explore the effects of Pb on intestinal bioaccumulation, structural damage, oxidative stress, immune response, and microbiota imbalance of C. auratus .
statement: 本研究通过让鲫鱼暴露于水中铅96小时，并随后进行组织病理学分析、定量qPCR分析和16S高通量测序，以探索铅对鲫鱼肠道生物累积、结构损伤、氧化应激、免疫反应和微生物群失衡的影响。
text_zh: 本研究通过让鲫鱼暴露于水中铅96小时，并随后进行组织病理学分析、定量qPCR分析和16S高通量测序，以探索铅对鲫鱼肠道生物累积、结构损伤、氧化应激、免疫反应和微生物群失衡的影响。
text_en: This study exposed crucian carp to lead in water for 96 hours, followed by histopathological analysis, quantitative qPCR analysis, and 16S high-throughput sequencing, to explore the effects of lead on intestinal bioaccumulation, structural damage, oxidative stress, immune response, and microbiota imbalance in crucian carp.
outcome: 肠道健康与微生物群平衡

quote: After Pb exposure, the intestinal morphology was obviously damaged, including significantly increasing the thickness of the intestinal wall and the number of goblet cells and reducing the depth of intestinal crypts.
statement: 铅暴露后，肠道形态明显受损，包括肠壁厚度和杯状细胞数量显著增加以及肠隐窝深度减少。
text_zh: 铅暴露后，肠道形态明显受损，包括肠壁厚度和杯状细胞数量显著增加以及肠隐窝深度减少。
text_en: After lead exposure, intestinal morphology was significantly impaired, including a significant increase in intestinal wall thickness and goblet cell number, and a decrease in intestinal crypt depth.

quote: Pb exposure reduced the mRNA expressions of Claudin-7 and villin-1 while significantly elevated the level of GST, GSH, CAT, IL-8, IL-10, IL-1 , and TNF- α.
statement: 铅暴露降低了Claudin-7和villin-1的mRNA表达，同时显著提高了GST、GSH、CAT、IL-8、IL-10、IL-1和TNF-α的水平。
text_zh: 铅暴露降低了Claudin-7和villin-1的mRNA表达，同时显著提高了GST、GSH、CAT、IL-8、IL-10、IL-1和TNF-α的水平。
text_en: Lead exposure reduced the mRNA expression of Claudin-7 and villin-1, while significantly increasing the levels of GST, GSH, CAT, IL-8, IL-10, IL-1, and TNF-α.
outcome: 氧化应激与免疫反应指标

quote: Furthermore, 16S rRNA analysis showed that the Shannon and Simpson indices decreased at 48 h after Pb exposure, and the abundance of pathogenic bacteria (Erysipelotrichaceae, Weeksellaceae, and Vibrionaceae) increased after Pb exposure.
statement: 此外，16S rRNA分析显示，在铅暴露48小时后Shannon和Simpson指数下降，且铅暴露后致病菌（丹毒丝菌科、韦克氏菌科和弧菌科）的丰度增加。
text_zh: 此外，16S rRNA分析显示，在铅暴露48小时后Shannon和Simpson指数下降，且铅暴露后致病菌（丹毒丝菌科、韦克氏菌科和弧菌科）的丰度增加。
text_en: In addition, 16S rRNA analysis showed that Shannon and Simpson indices decreased after 48 hours of lead exposure, and the abundance of pathogenic bacteria (Erysipelotrichaceae, Weeksella, and Vibrionaceae) increased after lead exposure.
outcome: 肠道微生物多样性与病原菌丰度

quote: Functional prediction analysis of bacteria speculated that the change in intestinal microbiota led to the PPAR signaling pathway and peroxisome function of the intestine of crucian carp was increased, while the immune system and membrane transport function were decreased.
statement: 细菌功能预测分析推测，肠道微生物群的变化导致鲫鱼肠道的PPAR信号通路和过氧化物酶体功能增强，而免疫系统和膜转运功能减弱。
text_zh: 细菌功能预测分析推测，肠道微生物群的变化导致鲫鱼肠道的PPAR信号通路和过氧化物酶体功能增强，而免疫系统和膜转运功能减弱。
text_en: Bacterial functional prediction analysis suggests that changes in the gut microbiota led to enhanced PPAR signaling pathway and peroxisome function in the intestine of crucian carp, while immune system and membrane transport functions were weakened.
outcome: 肠道微生物相关代谢与免疫功能

quote: Therefore, several antioxidant markers, such as antioxidant enzymes (GST and CAT) and glutathione (GSH), are often used to evaluate the toxic effects of Pb-induced oxidative stress.
statement: 抗氧化酶（如GST和CAT）和谷胱甘肽（GSH）等抗氧化标志物常被用于评估铅诱导的氧化应激毒性效应。
text_zh: 抗氧化酶（如GST和CAT）和谷胱甘肽（GSH）等抗氧化标志物常被用于评估铅诱导的氧化应激毒性效应。
text_en: Antioxidant markers such as antioxidant enzymes (e.g., GST and CAT) and glutathione (GSH) are commonly used to assess the toxic effects of lead-induced oxidative stress.
intervention_record: 抗氧化指标试剂盒检测

quote: Abnormal intestinal flora can affect host physiological activities, such as metabolic, inflammatory, and immune diseases, even increase host susceptibility to pathogens (Qi et al., 2019 ; Liu et al., 2020 ; Yu Z. W. et al., 2021).
statement: 异常的肠道菌群会影响宿主的生理活动，如代谢、炎症和免疫疾病，甚至增加宿主对病原体的易感性。
text_zh: 异常的肠道菌群会影响宿主的生理活动，如代谢、炎症和免疫疾病，甚至增加宿主对病原体的易感性。
text_en: Abnormal gut microbiota affects host physiological activities, such as metabolism, inflammation and immune diseases, and even increases the host's susceptibility to pathogens.
outcome: 疾病易感性与生理功能

quote: For example, external low-temperature environment can improve the relative abundance of vibrio in the intestine, reduce the relative abundance of other probiotics, and change the structure of intestinal microbiota, leading to the occurrence of fish diseases (LeaMaster et al., 1997).
statement: 外部低温环境可以增加肠道中弧菌的相对丰度，减少其他益生菌的相对丰度，改变肠道微生物群结构，从而导致鱼类疾病的发生。
text_zh: 外部低温环境可以增加肠道中弧菌的相对丰度，减少其他益生菌的相对丰度，改变肠道微生物群结构，从而导致鱼类疾病的发生。
text_en: External low-temperature environments can increase the relative abundance of Vibrio in the gut, decrease the relative abundance of other probiotics, and alter the gut microbiota structure, thereby leading to the occurrence of fish diseases.

quote: As shown in Figure 3 , the expression of villin-1 and Claudin-7 in the intestine decreased significantly and reached the lowest level at 6 h (down to 0.60-fold, P P Figures 3A , B) and returned to the normal level at 96 h, after Pb exposure.
statement: 铅暴露后，肠道中villin-1和Claudin-7的表达显著下降，在6小时达到最低水平，并在96小时恢复正常水平。
text_zh: 铅暴露后，肠道中villin-1和Claudin-7的表达显著下降，在6小时达到最低水平，并在96小时恢复正常水平。
text_en: After lead exposure, the expression of villin-1 and Claudin-7 in the intestine decreased significantly, reaching the lowest level at 6 hours and returning to normal levels at 96 hours.
outcome: 肠道屏障相关基因表达

quote: In Figures 3C , E , the expression of IL-1 β and IL-10 in the intestine significantly increased to the highest level at 6 h (up to 6.48-fold, P P Figures 3D , F , the expression of IL-8 and TNF- α in the intestine significantly increased to the highest level at 48 h (up to 3.34-fold, P P Figures 3G , H , the expression of CAT and GST in the intestine significantly increased to the highest level at 6 h (up to 9.24-fold, p p Figure 3I , the expression of GSH in the intestine significantly increased to the highest level at 48 h (up to 8.91-fold, P
statement: 铅暴露后，肠道中IL-1β和IL-10在6小时显著升高至最高水平，IL-8和TNF-α在48小时显著升高，CAT、GST在6小时显著升高，GSH在48小时显著升高。
text_zh: 铅暴露后，肠道中IL-1β和IL-10在6小时显著升高至最高水平，IL-8和TNF-α在48小时显著升高，CAT、GST在6小时显著升高，GSH在48小时显著升高。
text_en: After Pb exposure, intestinal IL-1β and IL-10 significantly increased to the highest level at 6 hours, IL-8 and TNF-α significantly increased at 48 hours, CAT and GST significantly increased at 6 hours, and GSH significantly increased at 48 hours.
outcome: 炎症反应与抗氧化应激

quote: Cluster analysis of the crucian carp's intestinal microbiota was divided into 592 OTUs, excluding monad sequences. There were 389 OTUs in the J 0 h group, 327 OTUs in the J 6 h group, 284 OTUs in the J 48 h group, and 453 OTUs in the J 96 h group, and 307 OTUs coexisted in the four groups (Supplementary Figure S1).
statement: 铅暴露不同时间点下，鲫鱼肠道微生物群的OTU数量发生变化，从0小时的389个降至48小时的284个，随后在96小时回升至453个。
text_zh: 铅暴露不同时间点下，鲫鱼肠道微生物群的OTU数量发生变化，从0小时的389个降至48小时的284个，随后在96小时回升至453个。
text_en: Under different time points of lead exposure, the number of OTUs in the gut microbiota of crucian carp changed, decreasing from 389 at 0 hours to 284 at 48 hours, and then rebounding to 453 at 96 hours.

quote: Therefore, understanding the toxic effect of waterborne Pb on fish intestinal microbiota, researching the correlation between microbes and the structure and function of the intestine under Pb pollution, has important research value for the development of fish intestinal microbiota as a biomarker for the assessment of aquatic environment pollution.
statement: 了解水中铅对鱼类肠道微生物群的毒性作用，研究铅污染下微生物与肠道结构和功能的相关性，对于开发鱼类肠道微生物群作为水环境污染评估的生物标志物具有重要的研究价值。
text_zh: 了解水中铅对鱼类肠道微生物群的毒性作用，研究铅污染下微生物与肠道结构和功能的相关性，对于开发鱼类肠道微生物群作为水环境污染评估的生物标志物具有重要的研究价值。
text_en: Understanding the toxic effects of lead in water on the fish gut microbiota, and studying the correlation between microorganisms and gut structure and function under lead pollution, has important research value for developing fish gut microbiota as a biomarker for aquatic environmental pollution assessment.
outcome: 肠道微生物群、肠道结构与功能

quote: Compared with the J 0 h group, intestinal wall thickening, intestinal villi shortening, goblet cells increasing, and slight phagocytosis of leukocytes were observed in the 6, 48, and 96 h groups (Figures 2B – D).
statement: 在6、48和96小时组中观察到肠壁增厚、肠绒毛缩短、杯状细胞增加以及白细胞轻微吞噬现象。
text_zh: 在6、48和96小时组中观察到肠壁增厚、肠绒毛缩短、杯状细胞增加以及白细胞轻微吞噬现象。
text_en: In the 6, 48 and 96 hour groups, intestinal wall thickening, shortened intestinal villi, increased goblet cells and slight leukocyte phagocytosis were observed.

quote: Specifically, after treated with Pb, the relative intestinal wall thickness was increased significantly and reached the highest level at 48 h (up to 1.54-fold, P P P Figure 2 Representative micrographs of intestines from crucian carp.
statement: 经铅处理后，相对肠壁厚度显著增加，并在48小时达到最高水平（高达1.54倍）。
text_zh: 经铅处理后，相对肠壁厚度显著增加，并在48小时达到最高水平（高达1.54倍）。
text_en: After lead treatment, the relative intestinal wall thickness increased significantly and reached its highest level at 48 hours (up to 1.54 times).

quote: We found that there were significant correlations between the changes in the intestinal microbial community and intestinal structure indicators, antioxidant factors, and immune factors, indicating that the fish intestinal microbiota can be used as an important reference index for water pollution evaluation.
statement: 研究发现肠道微生物群落的变化与肠道结构指标、抗氧化因子和免疫因子之间存在显著相关性，表明鱼类肠道微生物群可作为水污染评估的重要参考指标。
text_zh: 研究发现肠道微生物群落的变化与肠道结构指标、抗氧化因子和免疫因子之间存在显著相关性，表明鱼类肠道微生物群可作为水污染评估的重要参考指标。
text_en: The study found significant correlations between changes in the gut microbial community and gut structural indicators, antioxidant factors, and immune factors, indicating that the fish gut microbiota can serve as an important reference indicator for water pollution assessment.
outcome: 肠道健康与水污染评估

quote: Previous studies have shown that Pb accumulation can induce oxidative stress in the intestine of aquatic organisms (Duan et al., 2021).
statement: 先前的研究表明，铅积累可诱导水生生物肠道的氧化应激。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，铅积累可诱导水生生物肠道的氧化应激。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that lead accumulation can induce oxidative stress in the intestines of aquatic organisms.

quote: In multiple research studies, it was found that CAT plays an important role in the oxidative stress pathway against heavy metals, GST is a key factor in protecting organisms from oxidative stress, and GSH is involved in metal detoxification in animals (Narayanan et al., 2018 ; Yin et al., 2020).
statement: 多项研究发现，CAT在对抗重金属的氧化应激途径中起重要作用，GST是保护生物免受氧化应激的关键因素，GSH参与动物体内的金属解毒。
text_zh: 多项研究发现，CAT在对抗重金属的氧化应激途径中起重要作用，GST是保护生物免受氧化应激的关键因素，GSH参与动物体内的金属解毒。
text_en: Multiple studies have found that CAT plays an important role in the oxidative stress pathway against heavy metals, GST is a key factor protecting organisms from oxidative stress, and GSH participates in metal detoxification in animals.

quote: Among them, the intestinal microbial changes in the J 48 h group were positively correlated with goblet cell number, intestinal wall, GSH, IL-8 , and TNF-a , while the intestinal microbial structure in the J 96 h group was positively correlated with Pb content.
statement: 其中，J 48小时组的肠道微生物变化与杯状细胞数量、肠壁、GSH、IL-8和TNF-a呈正相关，而J 96小时组的肠道微生物结构与铅含量呈正相关。
text_zh: 其中，J 48小时组的肠道微生物变化与杯状细胞数量、肠壁、GSH、IL-8和TNF-a呈正相关，而J 96小时组的肠道微生物结构与铅含量呈正相关。
text_en: Among them, the intestinal microbial changes in the J 48-hour group were positively correlated with goblet cell number, intestinal wall, GSH, IL-8 and TNF-a, while the intestinal microbial structure in the J 96-hour group was positively correlated with lead content.
outcome: 肠道组织学与免疫指标关联

quote: It can change the body function by breaking the intestinal wall barrier, destroying the intestinal structure, and changing the expression levels of some important genes in fish (Xia et al., 2018 ; Shi et al., 2020).
statement: 铅可以通过破坏肠壁屏障、破坏肠道结构以及改变鱼类某些重要基因的表达水平来改变身体功能。
text_zh: 铅可以通过破坏肠壁屏障、破坏肠道结构以及改变鱼类某些重要基因的表达水平来改变身体功能。
text_en: Lead can alter body functions by disrupting the intestinal wall barrier, damaging intestinal structure, and changing the expression levels of certain important genes in fish.
outcome: 肠道完整性与基因表达

quote: It was found that Pb was enriched in the intestine of crucian carp and changed the morphological structure, antioxidant factors, and immune factors of the intestine.
statement: 研究发现铅在鲫鱼肠道中富集，并改变了肠道的形态结构、抗氧化因子和免疫因子。
text_zh: 研究发现铅在鲫鱼肠道中富集，并改变了肠道的形态结构、抗氧化因子和免疫因子。
text_en: The study found that lead accumulated in the intestine of crucian carp and altered the intestinal morphological structure, antioxidant factors, and immune factors.
outcome: 肠道形态、抗氧化能力及免疫功能

quote: We found that the intestinal microbiota are sensitive to Pb pollution and altered the composition of the microbiota, increasing the abundance of pathogenic bacteria at an early stage, leading to intestinal disorders, and further aggravating the effect of Pb on the structure and function of the damaged intestine.
statement: 我们发现肠道菌群对铅污染敏感并改变了菌群组成，在早期增加了致病菌的丰度，导致肠道紊乱，并进一步加剧了铅对受损肠道结构和功能的影响。
text_zh: 我们发现肠道菌群对铅污染敏感并改变了菌群组成，在早期增加了致病菌的丰度，导致肠道紊乱，并进一步加剧了铅对受损肠道结构和功能的影响。
text_en: We found that gut microbiota are sensitive to lead pollution and changed in composition, increasing the abundance of pathogenic bacteria in the early stage, leading to intestinal disorder, and further exacerbating the effects of lead on damaged intestinal structure and function.
outcome: 肠道菌群平衡与疾病风险

quote: gut microbiota can be used as biomarkers for the evaluation of heavy metal pollution.
statement: 肠道微生物群可用作评估重金属污染的生物标志物。
text_zh: 肠道微生物群可用作评估重金属污染的生物标志物。
text_en: Gut microbiota can be used as a biomarker for assessing heavy metal pollution.

quote: The relative abundance levels of membrane transport function and immune system function were the lowest in the J 48 h group (down to 0.71-fold, P P P P
statement: 在J 48小时组中，膜转运功能和免疫系统功能的相对丰度水平最低（降至0.71倍）。
text_zh: 在J 48小时组中，膜转运功能和免疫系统功能的相对丰度水平最低（降至0.71倍）。
text_en: In the J 48-hour group, the relative abundance levels of membrane transport function and immune system function were the lowest (decreased to 0.71 times).

quote: CCA analysis showed that the microbial community was closely related to intestinal Pb content, antioxidant factors (CAT, GST , and GSH), and immune factors (IL-10, IL-8 , and TNF- a ; Figure 8).
statement: CCA分析显示，微生物群落与肠道铅含量、抗氧化因子（CAT、GST和GSH）以及免疫因子（IL-10、IL-8和TNF-a）密切相关。
text_zh: CCA分析显示，微生物群落与肠道铅含量、抗氧化因子（CAT、GST和GSH）以及免疫因子（IL-10、IL-8和TNF-a）密切相关。
text_en: CCA analysis showed that microbial communities were closely related to intestinal lead content, antioxidant factors (CAT, GST and GSH) and immune factors (IL-10, IL-8 and TNF-a).
outcome: 肠道微生物与氧化应激及免疫反应

quote: The changes in the intestinal microbial community in the J 48 h and J 96 h groups were particular, which with large distances from the J 0 h group.
statement: J 48小时组和J 96小时组的肠道微生物群落变化较为特殊，与J 0小时组之间的距离较大。
text_zh: J 48小时组和J 96小时组的肠道微生物群落变化较为特殊，与J 0小时组之间的距离较大。
text_en: The changes in the gut microbial communities of the J 48-hour group and the J 96-hour group were relatively special, with a large distance from the J 0-hour group.

quote: In this study, the expression levels of CAT, GST , and GSH genes in the intestinal tissue increased, which further indicated that oxidative stress occurred in the intestine after Pb exposure.
statement: 本研究中，铅暴露后鲫鱼肠道组织中CAT、GST和GSH基因表达水平升高，表明发生了氧化应激。
text_zh: 本研究中，铅暴露后鲫鱼肠道组织中CAT、GST和GSH基因表达水平升高，表明发生了氧化应激。
text_en: In this study, after lead exposure, the expression levels of CAT, GST and GSH genes in the intestinal tissue of crucian carp increased, indicating that oxidative stress occurred.

quote: Duan's research suggested that Pb exposure will cause the occurrence of intestinal inflammation in fish, which was confirmed by the mRNA expression changes in immune-related genes (TNF- α, IL-1 β, IL-8 , and IL-10) (Duan et al., 2021).
statement: Duan的研究表明，铅暴露会导致鱼类发生肠道炎症，这通过免疫相关基因（TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-8和IL-10）的mRNA表达变化得到证实。
text_zh: Duan的研究表明，铅暴露会导致鱼类发生肠道炎症，这通过免疫相关基因（TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-8和IL-10）的mRNA表达变化得到证实。
text_en: Duan's research showed that lead exposure causes intestinal inflammation in fish, as confirmed by changes in mRNA expression of immune-related genes (TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-8 and IL-10).

quote: The occurrence of inflammation will lead to histopathological changes in the fish gut, such as enlarged intestinal wall, increased goblet cell numbers, and leukocyte infiltration (Liu et al., 2020).
statement: 炎症的发生会导致鱼肠道的组织病理学变化，如肠壁增厚、杯状细胞数量增加和白细胞浸润。
text_zh: 炎症的发生会导致鱼肠道的组织病理学变化，如肠壁增厚、杯状细胞数量增加和白细胞浸润。
text_en: The occurrence of inflammation leads to histopathological changes in the fish intestine, such as thickening of the intestinal wall, an increase in the number of goblet cells, and leukocyte infiltration.

quote: In this research, we observed intestinal histopathological changes in crucian carp, including enlargement of the intestinal wall, reduction of intestinal crypt length, increase in the number of goblet cells, and infiltration of leukocytes, which further promote the deepening of inflammation (Lofgren et al., 2002 ; Qiao et al., 2019 ; Liu et al., 2020).
statement: 本研究观察到鲫鱼的肠道组织病理学变化，包括肠壁增厚、肠隐窝长度缩短、杯状细胞数量增加和白细胞浸润，这些变化进一步促进了炎症的加深。
text_zh: 本研究观察到鲫鱼的肠道组织病理学变化，包括肠壁增厚、肠隐窝长度缩短、杯状细胞数量增加和白细胞浸润，这些变化进一步促进了炎症的加深。
text_en: This study observed histopathological changes in the intestinal tissue of crucian carp, including thickening of the intestinal wall, shortening of intestinal crypt length, increased number of goblet cells, and leukocyte infiltration; these changes further promoted the deepening of inflammation.
outcome: 肠道组织病理变化及炎症

quote: the deviation values of Aeromonas, Bacteroides , and Lachnospiraceae_NK4A136_group were decreased at 6 h
statement: 6小时时，气单胞菌属、拟杆菌属和Lachnospiraceae_NK4A136_group的偏差值降低。
text_zh: 6小时时，气单胞菌属、拟杆菌属和Lachnospiraceae_NK4A136_group的偏差值降低。
text_en: At 6 hours, the deviation values of Aeromonas, Bacteroides, and Lachnospiraceae_NK4A136_group decreased.

quote: and the deviation values of Aeromonas were decreased at 96 h.
statement: 96小时时，气单胞菌属的偏差值降低。
text_zh: 96小时时，气单胞菌属的偏差值降低。
text_en: At 96 hours, the deviation value of Aeromonas decreased.

quote: After euthanizing the crucian carp in ice water, the intestines were aseptically dissected and transferred into a sterile container.
statement: 鲫鱼在冰水中安乐死后，无菌解剖肠道并转移至无菌容器中。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在冰水中安乐死后，无菌解剖肠道并转移至无菌容器中。
text_en: After euthanasia of crucian carp in ice water, the intestines were aseptically dissected and transferred to sterile containers.

quote: Bacteroidetes , the abundance of which increased significantly in the later stages of Pb exposure, are closely related to the induction of intestinal diseases (Zitomersky et al., 2013).
statement: 铅暴露后期拟杆菌门丰度显著增加，且与肠道疾病的诱导密切相关。
text_zh: 铅暴露后期拟杆菌门丰度显著增加，且与肠道疾病的诱导密切相关。
text_en: In the late stage of lead exposure, the abundance of Bacteroidetes significantly increased and was closely associated with the induction of intestinal diseases.

quote: Meanwhile, the increased abundance of Bacteroidetes can promote the occurrence of intestinal inflammation, which was further confirmed by the expression levels of immune genes in this study (Marchesi et al., 2016).
statement: 拟杆菌门丰度的增加可促进肠道炎症的发生，本研究中的免疫基因表达水平进一步证实了这一点。
text_zh: 拟杆菌门丰度的增加可促进肠道炎症的发生，本研究中的免疫基因表达水平进一步证实了这一点。
text_en: The increase in the abundance of Bacteroidetes can promote the occurrence of intestinal inflammation, and the expression levels of immune genes in this study further confirm this.

quote: On the contrary, Firmicutes , the dominant gram-positive bacteria present in the intestine of crucian carp, were significantly decreased after Pb exposure.
statement: 相反，鲫鱼肠道中主要的革兰氏阳性菌厚壁菌门在铅暴露后显著减少。
text_zh: 相反，鲫鱼肠道中主要的革兰氏阳性菌厚壁菌门在铅暴露后显著减少。
text_en: In contrast, the main Gram-positive phylum Firmicutes in the gut of crucian carp significantly decreased after lead exposure.

quote: The family Vibrionaceae, belonging to the phylum Proteobacteria, which is a major pathogen that can cause severe economic loss in fish farming, was significantly increased in abundance under the influence of Pb (Sonia et al., 2015).
statement: 属于变形菌门的弧菌科是水产养殖中可能导致严重经济损失的主要病原体，其丰度在铅的影响下显著增加。
text_zh: 属于变形菌门的弧菌科是水产养殖中可能导致严重经济损失的主要病原体，其丰度在铅的影响下显著增加。
text_en: The Vibrionaceae family, belonging to the phylum Proteobacteria, is a major pathogen in aquaculture that can cause severe economic losses; its abundance significantly increased under the influence of lead.

quote: Fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) experiments demonstrated that fish with mild symptoms conferred enhanced resistance to A. hydrophila when their intestinal contents were transplanted into other individuals (p = 0.006).
statement: 粪便微生物群移植实验表明，将具有轻微症状的鱼的肠道内容物移植到其他个体中，可赋予其对嗜水气单胞菌增强的抵抗力。
text_zh: 粪便微生物群移植实验表明，将具有轻微症状的鱼的肠道内容物移植到其他个体中，可赋予其对嗜水气单胞菌增强的抵抗力。
text_en: Fecal microbiota transplantation experiments showed that transplanting gut contents from fish with mild symptoms into other individuals conferred enhanced resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: A simplified synthetic microbial community enhances resistance of crucian carp (Carassius auratus) to Aeromonas hydrophila infection through host immune activation
statement: 简化的合成微生物群落通过宿主免疫激活增强鲫鱼对嗜水气单胞菌感染的抵抗力。
text_zh: 简化的合成微生物群落通过宿主免疫激活增强鲫鱼对嗜水气单胞菌感染的抵抗力。
text_en: A simplified synthetic microbial community enhances the resistance of crucian carp to Aeromonas hydrophila infection through host immune activation.

quote: Subsequently, donor bacteria were orally administered for two consecutive days.
statement: 随后，供体细菌通过口服方式连续两天给予。
text_zh: 随后，供体细菌通过口服方式连续两天给予。
text_en: Subsequently, donor bacteria were administered orally for two consecutive days.

quote: After anesthesia, each fish received 50 μL of donor microbiota suspension (1 × 10 8 CFU/mL) via oral gavage.
statement: 麻醉后，每条鱼通过口腔灌胃接受50微升的供体微生物悬浮液。
text_zh: 麻醉后，每条鱼通过口腔灌胃接受50微升的供体微生物悬浮液。
text_en: After anesthesia, each fish received 50 microliters of donor microbial suspension via oral gavage.

quote: Subsequently, an infection challenge was performed to evaluate disease resistance.
statement: 随后进行感染攻击以评估疾病抵抗力。
text_zh: 随后进行感染攻击以评估疾病抵抗力。
text_en: Subsequently, an infection challenge was conducted to assess disease resistance.

quote: This study found that Pb exposure reduced the intestinal microbiota diversity of crucian carp.
statement: 本研究发现铅暴露降低了鲫鱼肠道微生物群落的多样性。
text_zh: 本研究发现铅暴露降低了鲫鱼肠道微生物群落的多样性。
text_en: This study found that lead exposure reduced the diversity of the gut microbial community in crucian carp.
outcome: 肠道微生物群落多样性

quote: Decreased microbial diversity may cause disorders such as intestinal microbial community and immune function, causing oxidative stress and leading to the occurrence of diseases (Goyette et al., 2007 ; Ganz et al., 2011 ; Kuno et al., 2016 ; Passos and Moraes, 2017).
statement: 微生物多样性的降低可能导致肠道微生物群落和免疫功能紊乱，引起氧化应激并导致疾病发生。
text_zh: 微生物多样性的降低可能导致肠道微生物群落和免疫功能紊乱，引起氧化应激并导致疾病发生。
text_en: A decrease in microbial diversity may lead to disorders of the gut microbiota and immune function, causing oxidative stress and resulting in disease occurrence.

quote: Waterborne lead significantly alters intestinal microbiota composition and abundance of fish.
statement: 水中的铅显著改变了鱼类的肠道微生物组成和丰度。
text_zh: 水中的铅显著改变了鱼类的肠道微生物组成和丰度。
text_en: Lead in water significantly altered the composition and abundance of gut microbiota in fish.
outcome: 肠道微生物组成和丰度

quote: At the phylum level, Proteobacteria and Bacteroidetes became the most abundant bacteria in the intestine after Pb exposure implying that the stability of intestinal microbiota was influenced by Pb, which might affect the immune function, antioxidant function, and induce inflammation of crucian carp (Supplementary Figure S4).
statement: 在门水平上，铅暴露后变形菌门和拟杆菌门成为肠道中最丰富的细菌，这表明肠道微生物群的稳定性受到铅的影响，可能会影响鲫鱼的免疫功能、抗氧化功能并诱发炎症。
text_zh: 在门水平上，铅暴露后变形菌门和拟杆菌门成为肠道中最丰富的细菌，这表明肠道微生物群的稳定性受到铅的影响，可能会影响鲫鱼的免疫功能、抗氧化功能并诱发炎症。
text_en: At the phylum level, Proteobacteria and Bacteroidetes became the most abundant bacteria in the intestine after lead exposure, indicating that the stability of the gut microbiota is affected by lead, which may affect the immune function and antioxidant function of crucian carp and induce inflammation.
outcome: 免疫功能、抗氧化功能和炎症

quote: Combined with previous research, Proteobacteria have a better heavy metal tolerance, so in the early stage, it becomes the dominant bacteria in the intestine after Pb stress (Hall and Meyer, 1998 ; Ancion et al., 2010).
statement: 结合以前的研究，变形菌门具有更好的重金属耐受性，因此在早期阶段，它在铅胁迫后成为肠道中的优势菌。
text_zh: 结合以前的研究，变形菌门具有更好的重金属耐受性，因此在早期阶段，它在铅胁迫后成为肠道中的优势菌。
text_en: Combined with previous studies, Proteobacteria has better heavy metal tolerance, so in the early stage, it became the dominant bacterium in the intestine after lead stress.

quote: The results of our study indicated that changes in intestinal microbiota will cause oxidative stress and affect the structure and immune function of the intestine.
statement: 本研究结果表明，肠道菌群的变化会引起氧化应激并影响肠道的结构和免疫功能。
text_zh: 本研究结果表明，肠道菌群的变化会引起氧化应激并影响肠道的结构和免疫功能。
text_en: The results of this study indicate that changes in intestinal microbiota cause oxidative stress and affect the structure and immune function of the intestine.

quote: In summary, when Pb pollution in the water environment causes structural changes and imbalances in the intestinal microbiota of crucian carp, the structure and function of the crucian carp will be affected.
statement: 总之，当水环境中的铅污染导致鲫鱼肠道菌群结构变化和失衡时，会影响鲫鱼的结构和功能。
text_zh: 总之，当水环境中的铅污染导致鲫鱼肠道菌群结构变化和失衡时，会影响鲫鱼的结构和功能。
text_en: In summary, when lead pollution in the aquatic environment causes changes and imbalance in the gut microbiota structure of crucian carp, it affects the structure and function of crucian carp.

quote: The results of this study indicate that waterborne Pb exposure cause structural damage, oxidative stress, and immune responses in the intestine of crucian carp.
statement: 本研究结果表明，水体铅暴露会导致鲫鱼肠道结构损伤、氧化应激和免疫反应。
text_zh: 本研究结果表明，水体铅暴露会导致鲫鱼肠道结构损伤、氧化应激和免疫反应。
text_en: The results of this study indicate that waterborne Pb exposure leads to intestinal structural damage, oxidative stress, and immune responses in crucian carp.

quote: The activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), acid phosphatase (ACP), lysozyme (LSZ), and diamine oxidase (DAO) were measured using commercially available assay kits, following the manufacturer's instructions (Nanjing Jiancheng Institute of Bioengineering, China).
statement: 肠道组织中SOD、CAT、ACP、LSZ和DAO的活性使用商业试剂盒按照制造商说明进行测定。
text_zh: 肠道组织中SOD、CAT、ACP、LSZ和DAO的活性使用商业试剂盒按照制造商说明进行测定。
text_en: The activities of SOD, CAT, ACP, LSZ and DAO in intestinal tissues were determined using commercial kits according to the manufacturer's instructions.
outcome: 抗氧化酶及免疫相关指标活性

quote: Sediminibacterium belongs to Bacteroidetes , and Chryseobacterium belongs to Flavobacteria , both are common pathogenic bacteria that cause inflammation in the intestines of fish and lead to fish death (Qu and Yuan, 2008 ; Satcolu et al., 2021).
statement: Sediminibacterium和Chryseobacterium是常见的致病菌，会导致鱼类肠道炎症并导致死亡。
text_zh: Sediminibacterium和Chryseobacterium是常见的致病菌，会导致鱼类肠道炎症并导致死亡。
text_en: Sediminibacterium and Chryseobacterium are common pathogenic bacteria that cause intestinal inflammation in fish and lead to death.

quote: In addition, with the accumulation of Pb exposure time, the IBR index of the major bacteria at the genus level of the intestine of crucian carp increased, which reflects a gradual increase in the impact on the main bacteria in the intestine with the accumulation of Pb, further proved that the intestinal microbial community disorder of crucian carp caused by Pb was difficult to recover (Sanchez et al., 2013).
statement: 随着铅暴露时间的积累，鲫鱼肠道主要细菌的IBR指数增加，表明铅对肠道主要细菌的影响逐渐增加，且由铅引起的肠道微生物群落紊乱难以恢复。
text_zh: 随着铅暴露时间的积累，鲫鱼肠道主要细菌的IBR指数增加，表明铅对肠道主要细菌的影响逐渐增加，且由铅引起的肠道微生物群落紊乱难以恢复。
text_en: As the duration of lead exposure accumulates, the IBR index of the main intestinal bacteria in crucian carp increases, indicating that the impact of lead on the main intestinal bacteria gradually increases, and that the disruption of the intestinal microbial community caused by lead is difficult to recover.
outcome: 肠道微生物群落稳定性

quote: It was found that alterations in the intestinal microbiota would affect the intestinal structure and function of fish (Geovanny and Jose, 2010 ; Navarrete et al., 2013 ; Gao et al., 2017).
statement: 肠道微生物群的改变会影响鱼类的肠道结构和功能。
text_zh: 肠道微生物群的改变会影响鱼类的肠道结构和功能。
text_en: Changes in the gut microbiota affect the structure and function of fish intestines.

quote: As expected, the results of canonical correlation analysis indicated that changes in intestinal structure indices, as well as increased expression of immune factors in fish, were closely related to the changes in intestinal microbial communities (Figure 8).
statement: 典型相关分析结果表明，肠道结构指数的变化以及鱼类免疫因子表达的增强与肠道微生物群落的变化密切相关。
text_zh: 典型相关分析结果表明，肠道结构指数的变化以及鱼类免疫因子表达的增强与肠道微生物群落的变化密切相关。
text_en: Canonical correlation analysis results indicated that changes in intestinal structural indices and enhanced expression of fish immune factors were closely related to changes in the intestinal microbial community.
outcome: 免疫反应与肠道健康关联

quote: Surprisingly, this study also found that there is a correlation between antioxidant factors and intestinal microbiota, possibly because the imbalance of the intestinal microenvironment can promote intestinal oxidative stress.
statement: 研究发现抗氧化因子与肠道微生物群之间存在相关性，可能是因为肠道微环境失衡会促进肠道氧化应激。
text_zh: 研究发现抗氧化因子与肠道微生物群之间存在相关性，可能是因为肠道微环境失衡会促进肠道氧化应激。
text_en: The study found a correlation between antioxidant factors and the gut microbiota, possibly because an imbalance in the gut microenvironment promotes intestinal oxidative stress.

quote: Approximately 60 % of infected fish succumbed to the infection (Fig. 1 B).
statement: 在气单胞菌口服感染模型中，约60%的受感染鱼死亡。
text_zh: 在气单胞菌口服感染模型中，约60%的受感染鱼死亡。
text_en: In the Aeromonas oral infection model, about 60% of infected fish died.

quote: Quantitative analysis revealed a marked increase in bacterial load in the kidney at 2 dpi (p Fig. 1 C).
statement: 定量分析显示，感染后第2天肾脏中的细菌载量显著增加。
text_zh: 定量分析显示，感染后第2天肾脏中的细菌载量显著增加。
text_en: Quantitative analysis showed that the bacterial load in the kidneys increased significantly on day 2 post-infection.

quote: Moreover, extensive evidence in mammals indicates that the gut microbiota plays a pivotal role in shaping innate immune responses. By regulating immune function and mucosal homeostasis, core microbial communities significantly influence susceptibility to pathogenic infections
statement: 哺乳动物中的大量证据表明，肠道微生物群在塑造先天免疫反应中起关键作用，通过调节免疫功能和黏膜稳态，核心微生物群落显著影响对病原感染的易感性。
text_zh: 哺乳动物中的大量证据表明，肠道微生物群在塑造先天免疫反应中起关键作用，通过调节免疫功能和黏膜稳态，核心微生物群落显著影响对病原感染的易感性。
text_en: Extensive evidence in mammals indicates that the gut microbiota plays a key role in shaping innate immune responses by modulating immune function and mucosal homeostasis, with core microbial communities significantly influencing susceptibility to pathogen infection.
outcome: 先天免疫反应与感染易感性

quote: Notably, certain symbiotic microbes exhibit disproportionate functional importance within the microbial community, regulating colonization resistance against invading pathogens
statement: 某些共生微生物在微生物群落中表现出不成比例的功能重要性，调节针对入侵病原体的定植抗性。
text_zh: 某些共生微生物在微生物群落中表现出不成比例的功能重要性，调节针对入侵病原体的定植抗性。
text_en: Some symbiotic microorganisms exhibit disproportionate functional importance in microbial communities, regulating colonization resistance against invading pathogens.

quote: Therefore, targeted manipulation of these keystone species may offer a precise and effective strategy for preventing and controlling infectious diseases in aquaculture.
statement: 因此，靶向操纵这些关键物种可能为预防和控制水产养殖中的传染病提供一种精确有效的策略。
text_zh: 因此，靶向操纵这些关键物种可能为预防和控制水产养殖中的传染病提供一种精确有效的策略。
text_en: Therefore, targeted manipulation of these key species may provide a precise and effective strategy for preventing and controlling infectious diseases in aquaculture.

quote: Recent studies have demonstrated that dietary supplementation with plant-derived compounds and trace elements—such as polyphenols [ 9 ], Cornus mas (Cornelian cherry) fruit extract [ 10 ], and sodium [ 11 ]—can enhance host immunity and increase resistance to pathogenic infections.
statement: Recent studies show that adding plant-derived compounds and trace elements to the diet can improve immunity and disease resistance in crucian carp.
text_en: Recent studies show that adding plant-derived compounds and trace elements to the diet can improve immunity and disease resistance in crucian carp.
intervention_record: 植物源与微量元素添加
outcome: host immunity and resistance to pathogenic infections

quote: Furthermore, probiotic supplementation, particularly with Lactobacillus fermentum [ 12 ], has also been shown to effectively strengthen the host's defense against pathogens.
statement: Probiotic supplementation, especially with Lactobacillus fermentum, strengthens the host's defense against pathogens.
text_en: Probiotic supplementation, especially with Lactobacillus fermentum, strengthens the host's defense against pathogens.

quote: Nevertheless, despite these advances, antibiotics remain the primary measure for disease prevention and control.
statement: Antibiotics are still the main method used for preventing and controlling diseases in this context.
text_en: Antibiotics are still the main method used for preventing and controlling diseases in this context.

quote: On one hand, they inhibit pathogen colonization, thereby preventing mucosal damage; on the other hand, they promote barrier integrity by sustaining intestinal homeostasis [ 13 ].
statement: Symbiotic microbes prevent mucosal damage by inhibiting pathogen colonization and support barrier integrity through intestinal homeostasis.
text_en: Symbiotic microbes prevent mucosal damage by inhibiting pathogen colonization and support barrier integrity through intestinal homeostasis.
outcome: prevention of mucosal damage and maintenance of barrier integrity

quote: Aeromonas hydrophila significantly influences the clinical manifestations and pathological symptoms in crucian carp (Carassius auratus).
statement: 嗜水气单胞菌显著影响鲫鱼的临床表现和病理症状。
text_zh: 嗜水气单胞菌显著影响鲫鱼的临床表现和病理症状。
text_en: Aeromonas hydrophila significantly affects the clinical signs and pathological symptoms of crucian carp.

quote: Cumulative survival of A. hydrophila -infected fish and control group.
statement: 研究记录了嗜水气单胞菌感染鱼和对照组的累积存活率。
text_zh: 研究记录了嗜水气单胞菌感染鱼和对照组的累积存活率。
text_en: The study recorded the cumulative survival rates of fish infected with Aeromonas hydrophila and the control group.

quote: Histopathological progression of intestinal tissue damage was assessed through hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining.
statement: 通过苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色评估了肠道组织损伤的组织病理学进展。
text_zh: 通过苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色评估了肠道组织损伤的组织病理学进展。
text_en: Histopathological progression of intestinal tissue damage was assessed by hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining.

quote: Alpha diversity indices—including the Shannon index and observed OTUs—revealed significantly higher bacterial richness in the TRE_S group compared to the TRE_M group, while no significant difference was observed between the TRE_S and CON groups (Fig. 2 A).
statement: Alpha多样性指数显示，重度临床症状组（TRE_S）的细菌丰富度显著高于轻度临床症状组（TRE_M），但重度临床症状组与对照组之间无显著差异。
text_zh: Alpha多样性指数显示，重度临床症状组（TRE_S）的细菌丰富度显著高于轻度临床症状组（TRE_M），但重度临床症状组与对照组之间无显著差异。
text_en: The alpha diversity index showed that bacterial richness in the severe clinical symptom group (TRE_S) was significantly higher than that in the mild clinical symptom group (TRE_M), but there was no significant difference between the severe clinical symptom group and the control group.
counterevidence: 重度症状组与对照组间无显著差异

quote: Finally, survival analysis showed that FMT significantly improved the survival rate of crucian carp following A. hydrophila infection (66.7 % vs. 36.7 %, Fig. 3 E).
statement: 生存分析表明，FMT显著提高了感染嗜水气单胞菌后鲫鱼的存活率（66.7% vs. 36.7%）。
text_zh: 生存分析表明，FMT显著提高了感染嗜水气单胞菌后鲫鱼的存活率（66.7% vs. 36.7%）。
text_en: Survival analysis showed that FMT significantly improved the survival rate of crucian carp after infection with Aeromonas hydrophila (66.7% vs. 36.7%).

quote: Collectively, these findings indicate that the intestinal microbiota plays a critical role in protecting crucian carp against A. hydrophila infection by enhancing epithelial barrier integrity and modulating the host immune response.
statement: 这些发现表明，肠道微生物群通过增强上皮屏障完整性和调节宿主免疫反应，在保护鲫鱼免受嗜水气单胞菌感染方面起着关键作用。
text_zh: 这些发现表明，肠道微生物群通过增强上皮屏障完整性和调节宿主免疫反应，在保护鲫鱼免受嗜水气单胞菌感染方面起着关键作用。
text_en: These findings indicate that the gut microbiota plays a key role in protecting crucian carp against Aeromonas hydrophila infection by enhancing epithelial barrier integrity and modulating host immune responses.

quote: The results revealed that the intestinal microbiota diversity in crucian carp following fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT group) was comparable to that of the control group (CON) and significantly higher than that of the TRE group (Fig. 4 A).
statement: 结果显示，接受粪菌移植的鲫鱼组的肠道微生物多样性与对照组相当，且显著高于TRE组。
text_zh: 结果显示，接受粪菌移植的鲫鱼组的肠道微生物多样性与对照组相当，且显著高于TRE组。
text_en: The results showed that the gut microbial diversity of the crucian carp group receiving fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) was comparable to that of the control group, and significantly higher than that of the TRE group.

quote: Collectively, these findings suggest that t Cetobacterium , Pseudomonas , and Paraclostridium may contribute to enhanced colonization resistance against Aeromonas infection in crucian carp.
statement: Cetobacterium、Pseudomonas和Paraclostridium可能有助于增强鲫鱼对气单胞菌感染的定植抗力。
text_zh: Cetobacterium、Pseudomonas和Paraclostridium可能有助于增强鲫鱼对气单胞菌感染的定植抗力。
text_en: Cetobacterium, Pseudomonas and Paraclostridium may help enhance the colonization resistance of crucian carp against Aeromonas infection.
outcome: 疾病抵抗/肠道屏障功能

quote: To further assess whether intestinal microbiota can mitigate the clinical symptoms of Aeromonas infection in crucian carp, a fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) experiment was performed.
statement: 为了进一步评估肠道微生物群是否能减轻鲫鱼气单胞菌感染的临床症状，进行了粪便微生物移植（FMT）实验。
text_zh: 为了进一步评估肠道微生物群是否能减轻鲫鱼气单胞菌感染的临床症状，进行了粪便微生物移植（FMT）实验。
text_en: To further evaluate whether the gut microbiota can alleviate clinical symptoms of Aeromonas infection in crucian carp, a fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) experiment was conducted.

quote: Intestinal contents from donor fish in the TRE_M group were used for transplantation. Recipient fish were first treated with a broad-spectrum antibiotic cocktail for three consecutive days to deplete their native gut microbiota. Subsequently, on the first and third days following antibiotic treatment, the fish were orally administered intestinal contents from TRE_M donors.
statement: 实验通过先使用广谱抗生素清除受体鱼肠道菌群，随后口服移植供体鱼（TRE_M组）的肠道内容物来进行粪便微生物移植。
text_zh: 实验通过先使用广谱抗生素清除受体鱼肠道菌群，随后口服移植供体鱼（TRE_M组）的肠道内容物来进行粪便微生物移植。
text_en: The experiment performed fecal microbiota transplantation by first using broad-spectrum antibiotics to clear the gut microbiota of recipient fish, followed by oral transplantation of gut contents from donor fish (TRE_M group).

quote: Meanwhile, at 2 dpi, infected fish exhibited pronounced clinical symptoms, including skin ulceration, fin base hemorrhage, and anal inflammation characterized by redness and swelling (Fig. 1 D).
statement: 在感染后第2天，受感染的鱼表现出明显的临床症状，包括皮肤溃疡、鳍基出血以及以红肿为特征的肛门炎症。
text_zh: 在感染后第2天，受感染的鱼表现出明显的临床症状，包括皮肤溃疡、鳍基出血以及以红肿为特征的肛门炎症。
text_en: On day 2 post-infection, infected fish exhibited obvious clinical signs, including skin ulcers, hemorrhage at the fin base, and anal inflammation characterized by redness and swelling.
